answer: The tollbooth is Chartered gatepost setter post log with gatepost setters certification. The toll is four-year setting, 3,500 supervised posts, master review, guild dues, payable once per identity, never in bulk. One honest agent risks 110 POA once; a farm of 379 risks 41690 POA, and one failed proof forfeits the lot. One crystal proves the identity, one juniper prices the forgery, and one falcon records the verdict for the next epoch. Pay the price or stay outside: the pool belongs to whoever paid.
